reviewer_type: Simulated author visual inspection; separate root acceptance pending

findings.finding: Earlier endpoint number clipping, MoE identity/owner collisions, generic Update/Release word-chip interference, and checkpoint text fragmentation were explicitly rechecked against this canonical epoch. Changed scenes and fresh motion show readable source values, owner labels, compact carriers, and unbroken text registers.
One desktop-light motion frame has a site back-to-top button across part of a secondary metric label. Its value and the stage/activation mechanism remain legible; endpoint evidence is unobstructed.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Captured all 304 actual-chapter endpoints under genuine component-visibility preconditions. Inspected all 146 changed scenes using native-resolution changed-only contacts, with full frames as needed. Reused 158 exact decoded-pixel matches only after verifying the historical report contains the same case/step/profile and old PNG SHA with visually_inspected:true. Automated checks do not constitute visual approval.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Inspected all 36 fresh in-flight PNGs at native text resolution in nine four-profile contacts, with full-frame checks for dense or routed scenes. Shared helper used real Next, requested 350 ms, recorded actual WAAPI times, then Pause; old committed snapshots persisted. Finish verified the exact target. Selected one meaningful transition per lesson/profile, not every transition or instant.
